prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage monument line plate. Image 1 is a documentary photograph of the ACTUAL extant building; use it for architecture and geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project's black ink line style sample, never a building-shape reference. Nijo Castle Ninomaru Palace, Kyoto, completed and enlarged by 1626. Draw specifically the extant Karamon-adjacent grand entrance (kurumayose) and Tozamurai exterior seen in the photo, with layered dark tiled hipped roofs and timber facade. Do not draw a castle keep. Wide landscape composition. Omit people, trees, sky, signs and surrounding scenery. Fine neutral BLACK architectural contours, sparse internal detail, no large shaded masses. Keep the complete subject centered with generous margin. Perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas inside and outside openings. No shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, gray wash, crosshatching, checkerboard, transparency, text, labels, frame or watermark.
